# Elect Zachary Carter

> Zachary Carter is running for Justice of the Peace, Precinct 2, Bastrop County, Texas. He brings 19 years of experience in corrections, law enforcement, Municipal Court, and Justice Court.

## About the Candidate

- [Full Candidate Profile](https://electzacharycarter.com/llm.txt): Complete biography, experience, platform, and role overview for Zachary Carter's campaign for Justice of the Peace.

## Pages

- [Home](https://electzacharycarter.com/): Campaign homepage with qualifications overview, personal statement, and JP role preview.
- [About Zachary](https://electzacharycarter.com/about/): Biography, 19-year career timeline across corrections, law enforcement, municipal court, and justice court.
- [The Role](https://electzacharycarter.com/about-the-role/): What a Justice of the Peace does in Texas, including criminal jurisdiction, civil cases, warrants, marriages, and inquests.
- [Get Involved](https://electzacharycarter.com/contact/): Volunteer, request a yard sign, or send a message to the campaign.

## Key Facts

- Office: Justice of the Peace, Precinct 2
- County: Bastrop County, Texas
- Experience: 19+ years in public service
- Background: Corrections, Law Enforcement, Municipal Court, Justice Court
